item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena is helping her grandmother clean rice on their farm in Punjab. Three statements about winnowing are listed. Which statements are correct?

1  Winnowing separates heavier and lighter parts of a mixture using moving air.
2  When the mixture is dropped from a height in a breeze, the lighter husk is carried farther away than the heavier rice grains.
3  Winnowing can also be used to separate the removed skins from peanuts when there is moving air.

statements.text: Winnowing separates heavier and lighter parts of a mixture using moving air.
When the mixture is dropped from a height in a breeze, the lighter husk is carried farther away than the heavier rice grains.
Winnowing can also be used to separate the removed skins from peanuts when there is moving air.
